import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import pinvh

# Example: test_zero_eigenvalue
try:
    a = np.array([[1, -1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]], dtype=float)
    p = pinvh(a)
    
    # Record the pseudoinverse
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)", p)
    
    # Record the Moore-Penrose condition: p @ a @ p ≈ p
    result_pap = p @ a @ p
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)::p @ a @ p", result_pap)
    
    # Record the difference for the first condition
    diff_pap = np.max(np.abs(result_pap - p))
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)::max_abs_diff_p@a@p", diff_pap)
    
    # Record the Moore-Penrose condition: a @ p @ a ≈ a
    result_apa = a @ p @ a
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)::a @ p @ a", result_apa)
    
    # Record the difference for the second condition
    diff_apa = np.max(np.abs(result_apa - a))
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)::max_abs_diff_a@p@a", diff_apa)
    
    # Also record whether the conditions are satisfied at atol=1e-15
    pap_satisfied = np.allclose(result_pap, p, atol=1e-15)
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)::p@a@p satisfies atol=1e-15", pap_satisfied)
    
    apa_satisfied = np.allclose(result_apa, a, atol=1e-15)
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)::a@p@a satisfies atol=1e-15", apa_satisfied)
    
except Exception as e:
    probe("a = np.array([[1,-1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]]); p = pinvh(a)", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import pinvh

a = np.array([[1, -1, 0], [-1, 2, -1], [0, -1, 1]], dtype=float)
p = pinvh(a)

# Moore-Penrose condition 2: p @ a @ p == p
residual_2 = np.linalg.norm(p @ a @ p - p)
probe('moore_penrose_cond2_buggy', residual_2)

# Moore-Penrose condition 3: a @ p @ a == a
residual_3 = np.linalg.norm(a @ p @ a - a)
probe('moore_penrose_cond3_buggy', residual_3)

# Also record the actual values for inspection
probe('pap_vs_p_buggy', np.max(np.abs(p @ a @ p - p)))
probe('apa_vs_a_buggy', np.max(np.abs(a @ p @ a - a)))
